name: ReportBench
description: ReportBench is a systematic benchmark designed to evaluate the content quality of research reports generated by large language models, focusing on citation quality, relevance, faithfulness, and factual consistency. It uses high-quality survey papers as gold standards and includes an agent-based automated framework for comprehensive evaluation.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark for evaluating LLM-generated research reports; it is promising but not yet broadly adopted as a standard community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on evaluating research report quality including citation faithfulness and factual consistency using automated and manual methods.
